description: This file defines the interface 'LoanTransactionValidator' which declares various methods for validating different types of loan transactions and related activities in the system. The interface serves as a contract for implementing classes that perform validation logic for loan transaction operations in the application.

classes.name: LoanTransactionValidator
classes.description: This interface declares validation methods for different loan transaction operations such as disbursement, refund, chargeback, repayment, and update actions, ensuring data integrity and business rule adherence.

methods.name: validateDisbursement
methods.description: Validates the disbursement request for a loan, considering transfer status and loan ID.

methods.name: validateUndoChargeOff
methods.description: Validates a request to undo a charge-off transaction.

methods.name: validateTransaction
methods.description: Performs validation on a generic transaction.

methods.name: validateChargebackTransaction
methods.description: Validates a chargeback transaction.

methods.name: validateNewRepaymentTransaction
methods.description: Validates a new repayment transaction.

methods.name: validateTransactionWithNoAmount
methods.description: Validates a transaction that has no amount specified.

methods.name: validateChargeOffTransaction
methods.description: Validates a charge-off transaction.

methods.name: validateUpdateOfLoanOfficer
methods.description: Validates an update to the loan officer.

methods.name: validateForBulkLoanReassignment
methods.description: Validates a bulk reassignment of loans.

methods.name: validateMarkAsFraudLoan
methods.description: Validates marking a loan as fraud.

methods.name: validateUpdateDisbursementDateAndAmount
methods.description: Validates updates to disbursement date and amount, given the disbursement details.

methods.name: validateNewRefundTransaction
methods.description: Validates a refund transaction.

methods.name: validateLoanForeclosure
methods.description: Validates loan foreclosure activities.

methods.name: validateLoanClientIsActive
methods.description: Ensures the associated loan client is active.

methods.name: validateLoanGroupIsActive
methods.description: Ensures the associated loan group is active.

methods.name: validateActivityNotBeforeLastTransactionDate
methods.description: Ensures the activity date is not before the last transaction date.

methods.name: validateRepaymentDateIsOnNonWorkingDay
methods.description: Validates that the repayment date falls on a non-working day, considering working days and permission to transact on such days.

methods.name: validateRepaymentDateIsOnHoliday
methods.description: Validates whether the repayment date falls on a holiday and whether transactions on holidays are allowed.

methods.name: validateLoanTransactionInterestPaymentWaiver
methods.description: Validates interest payment waiver transactions.

methods.name: validateLoanTransactionInterestPaymentWaiverAfterRecalculation
methods.description: Validates interest waiver transactions after interest recalculation.

methods.name: validateRefund
methods.description: Validates a refund transaction, considering loan, transaction type, date, and schedule data.

methods.name: validateRefundDateIsAfterLastRepayment
methods.description: Ensures the refund date is after the last repayment.

methods.name: validateActivityNotBeforeClientOrGroupTransferDate
methods.description: Validates that an activity date is not before the transfer date of client or group.

methods.name: validatePaymentDetails
methods.description: Validates payment-related details within a JSON element.

methods.name: validateIfTransactionIsChargeback
methods.description: Validates that the transaction is a chargeback.

methods.name: validateLoanRescheduleDate
methods.description: Validates the date for rescheduling a loan.

methods.name: validateNote
methods.description: Validates notes associated with transactions.

methods.name: validateExternalId
methods.description: Validates external identifiers for transactions.

methods.name: validateReversalExternalId
methods.description: Validates external IDs for reversal transactions.

methods.name: validateManualInterestRefundTransaction
methods.description: Validates manual interest refund transactions.

methods.name: validateClassificationCodeValue
methods.description: Validates classification code values for transactions.
